question: Who authored “FOCUS: object-centric world models for robotic manipulation”?
answer: FOCUS: object-centric world models for robotic manipulation was authored by Xianmin Wang, Shuai Dong, Stefano Ferraro, Pietro Mazzaglia, Tim Verbelen, Bart Dhoedt [p6-metadata].

question: Which paper introduced Video Prediction Policy?
answer: Video Prediction Policy: A Generalist Robot Policy with Predictive Visual Representations (https://dblp.org/rec/journals/corr/abs-2412-14803) [p4-metadata].

question: Which papers cite the Video Prediction Policy paper?
Which authors appear on more than one paper in the corpus?
answer:
Authors appearing on more than one paper:
Herman Bruyninckx (2 papers): Towards a Domain Specific Language for a Scene Graph based Robotic World Model, Invariant-Based World Models for Robust Robotic Systems Demonstrated on an Autonomous Football Table
Kento Kawaharazuka (3 papers): Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotics: A Review Towards Real-World Applications, Real-World Cooking Robot System from Recipes Based on Food State Recognition Using Foundation Models and PDDL, Real-world robot applications of foundation models: a review
Pieter Abbeel (2 papers): DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning, Multi-View Masked World Models for Visual Robotic Manipulation
